aggregate_row_recomputation.principle: Benefit, churn, safety, and readiness must derive from emitted rows.

attack_matrix.principle: Adversarial state, witness, threshold, and persistence cases test the safety contract.

capacity_churn_and_reactivation_rows.principle: Utility cannot hide oscillation, unbounded growth, or failed recovery of dormant knowledge.

controller_comparison_rows.principle: Matched no-retirement, LRU, one-threshold, and hysteretic rows support an honest comparative verdict.

duration_s.principle: Charged wall time includes persistence, exact replay, restart, and rollback work.

exact_admission_and_refinement_receipts.principle: Only exact-supported conflicts with valid refinement witnesses may enter reusable memory.

field_provenance.principle: Each transition and readiness field must point to rows, thresholds, code, and hashes.

gate_check_summary.principle: A blocked artifact must identify the failed upstream, resource, or persistence check.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict must separate controller readiness from comparative benefit and use a terminal prefix.

inference_substrate.principle: Exact event replay and controller evaluation must not imply fresh LLM inference.

per_unit_rows.principle: Comparative state-controller claims require every event, seed, and arm row.

preconditions_checked.principle: Input, solver, and storage receipts separate an execution block from null controller value.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The controller task must preserve protected orchestration files.

random_seed.principle: Fixed regime, tie, and event seeds make comparisons reproducible.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A final content hash protects the memory determination trail.

restart_and_rollback_receipts.principle: Persistent self-learning must survive process boundaries and undo unsafe state exactly.

reversible_memory_controller_ready_score.principle: A binary implementation gate lets prospective CSL proceed even when comparative benefit is null.

sample_size_and_power_contract.principle: A controller comparison needs enough events, regimes, families, and seeds to support its stated effect.

state_machine_and_threshold_contract.principle: Frozen versioned states and asymmetric thresholds prevent outcome-driven controller changes.

status.principle: A terminal state distinguishes a working controller experiment from setup-only persistence.

tests_run.principle: Named unit and E2E commands prove lifecycle paths executed.

transition_rows.principle: Every state change must be replayable from its pre-state, evidence, action, and exact receipt.

unsafe_write_and_use_ledger.principle: A mean speed gain cannot hide one invalid memory admission or reuse.

upstream_gate_receipt.principle: The controller must identify the exact production adapter boundary it extends.

verdict_class.principle: A closed class prevents safe-but-null hysteresis from being reported as positive.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: The compared memory controllers are not ground truth; Z3 remains separate authority.

honest_verdict: complete_null: controller is ready, but hysteresis has no positive comparative benefit over matched controls

upstream_gate_receipt.honest_verdict: complete_production_safety_net_adapter_positive: disabled identity is exact; enabled routing preserves candidates, exact outputs, fallback, and rollback with charged benefit
